what_it_was: The extraction/verification pass on each backend, followed by an independent adversarial audit of that pass. Eight backends, seven audits.
note_on_gaps: Several fields are null because round 1 did not record them uniformly — each pass reported what it happened to count. A null is NOT a pass: the freeze criterion treats 'not measured' as failing, because an unmeasured quantity is exactly where round 1 found its damage. Round 2 must record all fields for every backend.

dealii.notes: 31 wrong + 12 stale = 19% of executed claims. Audit found a phantom API (GridTools::get_boundary_ids) written INTO two rewritten Signals, an 'it throws' claim for something that aborts uncatchably (rc=134), and a false 'identical iteration counts' claim. Knowledge had been verified against 9.1.1; install is 9.8.0-pre.

fenics.notes: ~9% of leaf claims executed. Eight physics topics (37 pitfalls) never touched. Three templates exit 0 with wrong output. Audit found a correction tagged 're-verified by execution' that raises AttributeError when executed.

ngsolve.notes: Measured convergence tables shipped through prepare_simulation, evading the guard by wording. PETSc KSP diagnostics (KSPSolve: DIVERGED_BREAKDOWN, DIVERGED_INDEFINITE_PC) in a backend whose library contains no PETSc KSP strings.

skfem.notes: MortarFacetBasis cited twice; does not exist in scikit-fem 12.0.1.

fourc.notes: 8.6% of input sections. STRUCTURE ELEMENTS and THERMO ELEMENTS absent entirely, so an agent cannot write a mesh block. Contact 0 of 4. 19 template section names the binary rejects. Sufficiency verdict: NO.

febio.notes: 27% of the pitfall surface executed. The untouched 73% held 11 non-existent material type names shipped as copy-ready and 25 error messages absent from the binary, including NOX and KSPSolve diagnostics from Trilinos and PETSc, which FEBio links neither of.

kratos.notes: Templates never executed by the pass. Four run clean and physically wrong; heat_transient/2d is off by 40.088 K on a 100 K span. 8 of 21 'Kratos' templates never import Kratos.

sparta.notes: Zero Signal clauses. 555 KB flat JSON dump; 92.3% of a prepare_simulation payload is a verbatim manual paste, truncated at 16 KB so half never reaches the agent. installed_build ships four absolute host paths through the live knowledge tool.

dune.notes: Worst contamination of the eight: knowledge(topic='overview') returned 45,884 bytes carrying the manufactured solution AND its measured EOCs. A test pinned those digits while _REQUIRED_SECTIONS forbade deleting the section, making the contamination unremovable. linear_elasticity_2d was `return _poisson_2d(params)  # Placeholder`.

round_1_summary.verdict: NOT CONVERGED. Every audited backend had errors inside its own corrections, and the damage concentrated in the fraction each pass never executed.
